title: No scent at all
text:
No scent at all. I burned this candle for 3 hrs & it gave off no scent, at all.
I grew up in MA where authentic Yankee Candles were manufactured. The reason everyone paid extra was for the extraordinary scent, which filled the New England homes.
I bought 2 of these & neither of them give off any scent. Dollar store candles are better than these. Do Not Buy
